headline: Stock market: Sellers take the “pole position” due to fatigue and oil
summary: Greek stock market sellers took control amid fatigue and oil. Reports say a diplomatic agreement on ship passage through the Strait of Hormuz, with several restrictions, is being prepared.
why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market. The Strait of Hormuz is a key oil shipping route, so developments there move crude prices and shipping costs.
why_moved: Sellers dominated the session, with oil cited as a factor. Reported talks on Hormuz passage restrictions add uncertainty over Gulf oil shipments.
